description_en: Queries the backup settings of a cluster
name: DescribeBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to view the details of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in the destination region, including the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

BackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The number of days to retain data backups

EnableBackupLog.description_en:
Indicates whether real-time log backup is enabled. Valid values:

Enable: enabled.

Disable: disabled
EnableBackupLog.description_zh:
是否开启日志（实时）备份。取值说明：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭

LogBackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The number of days to retain log backups

PreferredBackupPeriod.description_en:
The data backup cycle. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:

Monday

Tuesday

Wednesday

Thursday

Friday

Saturday

Sunday
PreferredBackupPeriod.description_zh:
数据备份周期，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开。取值：

Monday：周一；
Tuesday：周二；
Wednesday：周三；
Thursday：周四；
Friday：周五；
Saturday：周六；
Sunday：周日

PreferredBackupTime.description_en: The data backup time. The time is in the HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ format
